defects.description: Members-only 10% discount (subtotal >= 10,000 yen) computed in a scriptlet; the view stores the result in the session attribute "discount", which OrderConfirmServlet later trusts
Consumption tax (10%, rounded down) and order total computed in a scriptlet and written to the session (orderTax / orderTotal); the servlet persists these values without recomputing them
Cart line amount (price x quantity) calculated client-side in jQuery and shown to the user, duplicating CartLine.getLineTotal() on the server
Scriptlet if on the session user's role ("admin") hides the product maintenance link
Admin role checked only in a scriptlet in the JSP; AdminProductEditServlet and LoginFilter check login only, so a customer's POST (save / delete) is executed
Postal code format NNN-NNNN checked only in jQuery (pattern at validation.js:5, field at entry.jsp:53); OrderEntryServlet.java:63 checks presence only, so "1000001" is accepted
Keyword text input has only a placeholder: no <label>, aria-label or aria-labelledby
Phone input has visible text "電話番号" in a <span class="form-label"> (line 61) but no id and no <label for> association
Product thumbnail in the results table has no alt attribute
Cart notes text uses .cart-notes (common.css:125, #aaaaaa at 12px) on the white page background: contrast about 2.3:1
Standalone login page (does not include header.jspf) declares <html> without a lang attribute
Per-line remove button (削除) submits the form immediately: no confirmation, no undo
Delete product button submits immediately and deletes the product: no confirmation, styled as an ordinary secondary button
Validation failure shows only "エラーが発生しました" although the servlet knows which fields failed (name / price / stock / category); no field or cause is named
Save button hand-built with inline styles (#1a73e8, padding 4px 20px, radius 12px, 13px font) instead of WEB-INF/tags/button.tag (.btn-primary: #0066cc, 6px 16px, radius 3px, 14px)
Primary blue defined four ways: #0066cc (common.css:22,32,60,131,137), #06c (common.css:14, links), #0a66c2 (admin.css:13,26) and inline #1a73e8 (product-edit.jsp:54)

Near-identical grays with no token: light fills #eeeeee / #efefef / #f4f4f4 / #f5f5f5 (+ admin.css #f2f2f2), borders #dddddd / #ddd / #e0e0e0 (+ admin.css #e5e5e5, #d9d9d9), text #333333 / #333 / #444444 / #444
Add-to-cart action labelled "カートに入れる" on the detail screen but "カートに追加" on the search results (search.jsp:48 via messages_ja.properties:12 search.addToCart)
Order complete page has no link or button at all (no header include, no menu link, no logout); the only way out is the browser back button or typing a URL
FAQ page outside WEB-INF that no screen, fragment or script links to; reachable only by typing the URL
Email address is required and left empty although the logged-in user's email is known (User.email, shown on /menu at menu.jsp:34); OrderEntryServlet pre-fills the shipping name but not the email
